build_encodec_24khz_model: build a pretrained EnCodec 24kHz audio compression model using EncodecModel.encodec_model_24khz
build_encodec_48khz_model: build a pretrained EnCodec 48kHz stereo audio compression model using EncodecModel.encodec_model_48khz
encode_audio_waveform: encode a raw audio waveform tensor into discrete codebook frames using EncodecModel.encode
decode_audio_frames: decode encoded codebook frames back into a raw audio waveform tensor using EncodecModel.decode
set_target_bandwidth: set the target compression bandwidth on an EnCodec model using EncodecModel.set_target_bandwidth
